name: Ben Archer

tenures.note: Epic Wrestling's own biography card ('"The Icon" Ben Archer'), its three surviving Ground Zero shows and its title history, which has him win the World Heavyweight Championship from Seth Anson at Vengeful Hearts, 24 February 2002.
tenures.role: wrestler: World Heavyweight Champion from Vengeful Hearts, 24 February 2002

caption: The Icon, born outside London by his own card, who came to Epic Wrestling when it bought out the bankrupt CWF and won its World Heavyweight Championship from Seth Anson at Vengeful Hearts on 24 February 2002.

name: Charles Lee

tenures.note: Epic Wrestling's own biography card and its Ground Zero shows, where he and Jonathan Mills feud with Brandon Lopez.

entrance_music.verbatim: "Be Quick or Be Dead" by Iron Maiden

caption: A Greensboro high flyer who, with Jonathan Mills, feuded with Brandon Lopez through Epic Wrestling's Pouring The Gasoline segments of December 2001.

name: Brandon Lopez

tenures.note: Epic Wrestling's own biography card ('the younger brother of wrestling superstar, Carlos Lopez') and its Ground Zero shows.

caption: Carlos Lopez's younger brother, a rookie powerhouse finishing with La Bomba de la Perra, whose feud with Charles Lee and Jonathan Mills ran through Epic Wrestling's Ground Zero shows.

name: Douglas Petty

tenures.note: Epic Wrestling's own biography card and its Ground Zero shows; on 17 December 2001 he beats the Hardcore Isosceles Trapezoid in a hardcore match to earn a match with Levond Daniels.

caption: A Greensboro technician, the best student of Shawn Arrows' training camp by his own card, who beat the Hardcore Isosceles Trapezoid in a hardcore match on 17 December 2001 to earn a match with Levond Daniels.

name: E.G.O.

tenures.note: Epic Wrestling's own biography card, '"E.G.O." Eugene Gregory Oswald', current team 'EGOtistical w/"Self-Professed" Trent Daniels'.

entrance_music.verbatim: The Way I Am by Eminem

caption: Eugene Gregory Oswald, a Beverly Hills rule-breaker thrown out of Jonathan Conspiracy's Hell's Kitchen school, whose tag team EGOtistical with Trent Daniels caught Epic Wrestling's scouts by his own card.

name: Enforcer

tenures.note: Epic Wrestling's own biography card and its Ground Zero shows.

caption: An Albany brawler who renounced the respect he had shown High Flyer on Epic Wrestling's Ground Zero of 10 December 2001 and pinned Ben Archer that night to keep the World Heavyweight Championship for his partner Seth Anson.

identity.note: A generic shared name. This Enforcer is Epic Wrestling's of 2001 and 2002, whose own promo of 10 December 2001 names XWO and LoW as his past; no document of Epic's names any of the others, nor enforcer-rspwf, the newsgroup's Enforcer.

name: Kenny Knuckles

tenures.note: Epic Wrestling's own biography card: past promotions Prof. Championship Wrestling, uKw, Dream Wrestling, oWa, Fighting Zone and Five Star Wrestling.

caption: A hard-drinking Bronx brawler and veteran by his own Epic Wrestling card, who finishes with the Knuckledriver and would sooner be disqualified for a steel chair to an opponent's head than lose a close match.

name: Doozer

tenures.note: Epic Wrestling's own biography card, its Ground Zero shows and its history page, which names 'DWF Hall of Famer - Doozer' among the CWF roster it bought.

caption: A self-styled superhero raised in Fenway Park, a DWF Hall of Famer by his own card, who came to Epic Wrestling with his manager The Dude and his LoW tag partner Jason Winters.

name: Steven Windsor

tenures.note: Epic Wrestling's own biography card, captured in October 2002.

caption: The Golden Bear, a Calgary powerhouse and former physical trainer whose Epic Wrestling card tells his life from his birth in Edmonton to his first matches in Calgary Championship Wrestling.

identity.note: A bare shared name. This Steven Windsor is the Golden Bear of Epic Wrestling's card of 2002, whose card lists no past promotion; no document names him with PURE's or the fWo's.

name: Sam Potright
notes: The H.I.T.'s own archenemy, per PURE's own column page: “The HITs archenemy, Sam Potright of IWO, was seen in the audience at Ikusa during The HITs match” (promotions/pure/archive/columns.html, 2 May 2002). IWO's own, not PURE's — no PURE tenure recorded here, since the only surviving appearance is sitting in another fed's own crowd. No promotion is held for IWO (see the frontier ledger); no tenure entry is recorded here rather than guessing one.
caption: The H.I.T.'s own archenemy, named once in PURE's own column page while sitting in the crowd at Ikusa — an IWO wrestler, never a PURE one.

tenures.note: Epic Wrestling's Ground Zero of 17 December 2001 introduces him as 'an extreme legend, an eventual IWO legend, a cornerstone of IOW' come for personal reasons; on 4 February 2002, as Samuel Potright, he beats Brandon Lopez with War Within A Breath and attacks the Hardcore Isosceles Trapezoid after his title defence; its title history has him take the North American Championship from The H.I.T. at Vengeful Hearts.
tenures.role: wrestler: North American Champion from Vengeful Hearts, 24 February 2002
